items.material_issue: Lore text is rendered faithfully: rulers, causality of Southspar's decline, the halfling withdrawal, the stralite-dust threat, and both numbers are preserved.
items.evidence: "increased twenty-fold" → "提高到原来的二十倍"; "agreed to pay thirty times the previous amount" → "以30倍的价钱签订了协议"; "manipulated the king into mining it and selling it to them for a fraction of its true worth" → "利用这个国王去开采并将蓝锆石以一个极低的价格卖给他们". Deviations are stylistic only (e.g. "most obvious and immediate threat" → "最大也最明显的威胁", "Army of Rogues" → "游击军").

items.material_issue: Quantity, count of timelines, and the choice prompt are all preserved.
items.evidence: "lived %d turns in three different timelines" → "在三条不同的时间线里度过了 %d 个回合"; "Which do you choose to be the real timeline?" → "你选择哪一条作为现实时间线？"

items.material_issue: Polarity and intent of the reversal are preserved.
items.evidence: "No actually, perhaps life is still worth it!" → "不，其实生命或许依然值得活下去！"

items.material_issue: Speaker, referent (the Orb of Many Ways) and the disbelief polarity are preserved; only the elliptical clause naming the orb as the means of travel is compressed, which does not assert anything false.
items.evidence: "Surely you don't possess the Orb of Many Ways!" → "你拿到的肯定不是多元水晶球！"; "That you used to travel here from Maj'Eyal?" → "你说你是从马基·埃亚尔来的？" (still conveys arrival from Maj'Eyal in the same orb-related exchange).

items.material_issue: Timing (too late), the rival's completion, the transaction, and the grudging tone are preserved; "这些原料" merely names what "these" refers to in the hand-in.
items.evidence: "You're too late. %s has already finished" → "你来太晚了。%s已经完成了"; "take these and give you your undeserved reward" → "收下这些原料、把你不配得到的奖励给你"

items.material_issue: Speaker, the implied killing of the guards, and the question are preserved.
items.evidence: "your men... they were in my way" → "你的人……挡了我的路"

items.material_issue: The talent requirement is rewritten: English states a single either/or condition, while the Chinese adds a mandatory conjunct (Gestalt must be sustained) and turns the disjunction into "AND (A or B)". A player would believe an extra prerequisite exists that the English string does not state, and no fixed_context supports the addition.
items.evidence: "You must have either a psionic damage shield active or Improved Gestalt available" → "你必须在格式塔处于激活状态，并且有一个精神护盾或强化格式塔不在冷却中时" — "格式塔处于激活状态，并且" has no counterpart in the source; fixed_context is empty.

items.material_issue: Action and timing preserved; "竞技场" only makes the implicit location explicit and the %s payload is retained.
items.evidence: "You take a look at the ranking boards before entering.\n%s" → "进入竞技场前，你查看了一下排名榜。\n%s"

items.material_issue: Recognition, referent (the apprentice mage) and prior meeting in the wilds are preserved; only "I met" is compressed into the attributive.
items.evidence: "You're that apprentice mage I met in the wilds!" → "你不就是那个荒野之中的法师学徒么？"

items.material_issue: Race origin, dependence on runes, Spellhunt survival condition, unlock condition and the three feature bullets are all preserved.
items.evidence: "created (and subsequently abandoned) by the Conclave during the Allure Wars" → "孔克雷夫创造了食人魔作为工人和战士，但最后他们成为了被遗弃的种族"; "only those who fled to Shalore lands survived extermination" → "只有那些逃去永恒精灵领地的少量族群幸免于难"; "all kind of runes and infusions" → "各种纹身和符文".

items.material_issue: The servant race is mistranslated: "yeeks" is rendered as "夺心魔" (mind flayers/illithids), a different creature entirely. This changes the narrative fact of which race served in the facility and contradicts the accompanying description of small, useless servants with oversized heads.
items.evidence: "I'll be glad to get rid of these disgusting yeeks... Why we ever decided to use these useless creatures as servants" → "能摆脱这些令人作呕的夺心魔真让我高兴……我们当初究竟为什么会决定让这些无用的生物当仆从"; the rest of the log (subject outcomes A–N, dates, "lanklegs" → "长腿") is accurate.

items.material_issue: State of the creation (unfinished but functional), its purpose, the future invulnerability, and the remaining step are all preserved.
items.evidence: "While it remains unfinished, it is finished enough to serve in its purpose of protecting my lair" → "虽然尚未彻底完成，却已经足以履行守卫我巢穴的使命"; "once it is complete it will be nigh invulnerable" → "等到它完全完成，更将近乎无敌".

items.material_issue: Rival's achievement during the player's absence and the threat to the speaker's position are preserved; "一瓶" is a natural classifier for the created elixir placeholder.
items.evidence: "in your overlong absence, %s has managed to create a %s" → "在你离开的漫长时间里，%s已经设法配制出了一瓶%s"; "if he steals my rightful spot" → "要是他抢走了本该属于我的席位".
